Unión Deportiva Logroñés, S.A.D. is a Spanish football team based in Logroño, in the autonomous community of La Rioja. Founded in 2009, it currently plays in Primera Federación – Group 1, holding home matches at Estadio Las Gaunas, with a capacity of 16,000 seats.
